title: North Haven contracts with Alvin Beverage for Beach Bridge
description: The North Haven Historical Society's illustrated Pulpit Harbor Bridges exhibit reproduces a historical contract between the town and Alvin Beverage concerning Beach Bridge between Blue Point and Beverage Point. The publication describes the town's 1883 bridge approval and preserves historical photographs. It does not independently identify Alvin's parents or provide a chain of title for the land at either end.
place: Beach Bridge, Pulpit Harbor, North Haven, Maine
evidence_status: Original document image reproduced on historical society exhibit PDF p. 8; genealogy identity and land title still unverified

sources.title: The Pulpit Harbor Bridges — 1883 contract and historic photographs

sources.supports: Historic bridge construction contract references Alvin Beverage; images appear in exhibition
sources.evidence_level: Tier 1 original-document reproduction within later local-history exhibit; transcription/image needs archival inspection

title: Historical society reports Harrison Beverage acquired the lower Mill Stream dam
description: The North Haven Historical Society's Mill Stream exhibit reports that Harrison Beverage purchased the lower dam in 1888 and built a bridge on the site. The property record and individual's exact identity have not been examined; the existing Harrison Beverage (born 1825) is a candidate only.
place: Mill Stream, Pulpit Harbor, North Haven, Maine
evidence_status: Historically reported deed transaction; original 1888 deed and person identity not verified

sources.title: The Mill Stream — North Haven Historical Society exhibit

sources.evidence_level: Tier 3 later historical narrative; original deed still to be found
